provenance: Historical manifest for Experiments 01–10. It records the executed evidence chain; it does not claim that reconstructed source is original source.

experiments.result: 128-point synthetic baseline; one retained run recovered the hidden 2870 MHz resonance with ~37.2 kHz error.
At N=15, session medians were ~88.8 kHz Fixed, ~121.7 kHz Random, ~24.9 kHz AQIE.
Strong structured model mismatch degraded AQIE and exposed model dependence.
Residual adequacy gate intercepted strong mismatch as WARN/STOP in the executed trial set.
At N=20, strong-mismatch median error changed from ~484.8 kHz AQIE to ~294.4 kHz twin-governed AQIE.
At N=30, strong-mismatch median error changed from ~459.3 kHz to ~92.8 kHz with hierarchical escalation.
Naive sparse AQIE locked onto the wrong region (~148 MHz error), motivating discovery before exploitation.
Discovery removed catastrophic lock-on; single-model inference became inadequate as additional structure was exposed.
Reduced-data model selection chose a two-resonance family and progressively converged.

experiments.evidence: full recorded trace used for evaluation reference
experiments.result: M2S preferred among tested models; fitted centers ~2861.399 and ~2869.730 MHz. Adaptive error vs primary full-fit center reached ~32.6 kHz at N=60 and ~11.7 kHz at N=80.
